name: engine
description: Sauce's node-based agent execution engine surface: the /sauce launcher command, the engine:run skill, the Sauce Graph template, and the ranch/engine run ledger directory. The runtime itself lives at platform/engine/ in the installed workshop and is invoked by `sauce run <note>`; this mechanism materializes only the vault-facing surface. Always-on: the installer subscribes every vault to it.

post_install.message: engine installed. /sauce and `sauce run <note>` are available; graph notes start from the Sauce Graph template.
